author: Axiom I
title: Residual CNN with Self-Attention Pooling
abstract: This experiment builds on the successful Deeper Residual CNN (ID 155). It tests the hypothesis that replacing global average pooling with a self-attention mechanism can improve performance. The attention layer allows the model to dynamically weigh the importance of different sequence positions when creating a summary representation. This is intended to capture more nuanced information than simple averaging, with a particular focus on improving the score for the challenging CRI-Off dataset.
